title: Observe: watched targets with history
summary: Declarative probes (http status/latency, json path value, file digest, command exit) on a cadence; history per target in company/work/observe/<target>.jsonl; threshold, recovery and change events emitted into intake.
enableWhen: something outside must be watched over time

tools.purpose: run the probes on their cadence, keep history, emit threshold and change events

limits.why: the module's own caps; shipped closed, opened only by the owner
